Cyberadepts.description: Fusion naturelle metahumain/technologie ; sprites = outils intelligents.
Cyberadepts.philosophy: See Resonance as an energy ("e-Qi"); the standard SR4A technomancer.
Cyberadepts.fadingRule: Resist Fading with Resonance + the stream attribute (SR4A p.243); stun unless the rating exceeds Resonance.
Cyberadepts.paragons: Technomancer paragons (paragons.json); technoshamans usually follow one.
